description: Render PDF pages to PNG or JPEG. DPI is 72 to 216. A page range such as 1-3,5 is optional. At most 24 pages and 25 MB of images. Send base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused. Returns image base64 and a ZIP when there is more than one page.

data.description: PDF bytes as base64 or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB. Provide data or url.

quality.description: JPEG quality from 1 to 100. Ignored for PNG.

range.description: Pages to render, such as 1-3,5. Blank renders every page, up to 24.

url.description: Public URL of a PDF. Private and local addresses are refused. Provide data or url.

name: render_pdf_pages

zip.description: ZIP of the images when there is more than one, otherwise null.

title: Render PDF pages
